title: Storm Sorceress and Phoenix
description: A white-haired female figure in ornate white and gold attire floats dynamically above a dark fantasy city rooftop, holding a glowing blue staff in one hand while reaching forward with the other. A large ethereal blue phoenix with fiery orange accents flies beside her as swirling storm clouds, rain, and magical energy fill the dramatic sky.
